1 star.

title: Changed my life
body:
I just wanted to say THANK YOU! Your app has literally changed my life for the better. A year ago, I was 215lbs at 5’2” and freshly diagnosed with T2 diabetes. I’m 22, I thought my life was over - I’ve seen this play out in my family across generations. I was terrified of what my life would be. 

I started nutrition and diabetes education, and my educator told me about Ladder. I thought in my head “I’m screwed anyway, no reason to try.” But then I kept getting messages from Coach Nicole about starting my workouts, and I thought “maybe I’ll just work out to get this lady to leave me alone.” Best decision of my life. After 25 weeks of consistency in workouts and nutrition, I’m 152lbs and my diabetes is fully in remission. I had labs done and for the first time in my life EVERYTHING was normal. I’m no longer on that path anymore, and every day I think how grateful I am for the chance to change my life.

So, thank you for giving me the tools to save my own life.

title: Excellent

I have recommended this app to several friends who’ve all downloaded it and love it. There is so much more I left out! If you’re on the fence, I highly recommend trying the 30-day free trial. You’ll be hooked. And you can’t beat the price!

title: Holds me accountable
body: For some reason, this app keeps me from skipping on my workouts. I can’t seem to eat or sleep consistently, or log those things, but when it comes to exercise…? I’m on it! I feel so much stronger now than I did a few months ago when I was mostly practicing yoga and doing whichever workouts I could find on YouTube. That wasn’t sustainable and I wasn’t progressing. LADDER helps me keep track of my workouts, and log my weights, reps, and sets. It works seamlessly with my Apple Watch so I can track my stats while listening to music during a workout. Also, it’s a gorgeous app that gives you crystal clear demonstrations of each move as you listen to your coach’s instructions. LADDER is easy to navigate and customize. I can switch up my workout plan, decide which is going to be my rest day, and complete other workouts that aren’t part of my team or plan (flex workouts). Oh that’s right- LADDER has a bunch of teams. Each one has a different style/ approach and you can switch through them as you figure out your own style. The coaches and your teammates are available in team chats. I can’t get over how great this app is and the many features you get for a yearly membership. I definitely will renew my membership every year!

This is for every level of person making fitness apart of their daily routine. 100/10 can’t recommend enough!

title: Worth it!
body: I’ve been using this consistently since the beginning of the year. Has kept me on track. Worth the price!!

title: Out of the rut
body: After years of lifting and running and a few injuries this is helping to regain my strength ! This has helped me to to get back into a routine without over exerting myself after coming back from injury and trying to regain momentum

title: Great app
body: Love the app but have frustration that a rating/review is required after each workout. It is tedious.

title: Great app with one thing missing - EDIT: FIXED
body:
EDIT: They fixed it. Rating updated.

I love this app. I use it daily and have only one complaint. I’ve rated it 4 stars only because I CAN’T EXTEND MY REST BREAKS! Anyone who trains seriously knows that recovery is paramount to muscle growth, and taking longer rest breaks in between sets is a great way to maximize muscle growth. All I’m asking is that the developers please add a feature that allows me to add time to my rest breaks in 30 second intervals. Please make this happen!

title: Looooovvvveeeee Ladder
body: Define has helped me so much in my journey to a healthier life style. Coach Maia helps me stay on track even on the harder days when life is just life-ing 😅 … thank you LADDER for popping up on my pages

title: Great app
body: Love the app and the variety of work outs. I think there are some small tweaks within the app that could make it more user friendly but overall an excellent value! Not having to think and plan workouts every day is a huge time saver!

title: Great APP
body: This has been one of the best apps I’ve used and I’ve used many. I feel that I have gained a lot of strength and a lot of knowledge with Coach Kellee. Keep up the good work and I would highly recommend this app to beginners intermediate and advance.

title: New user
body: This reignited my spark for the gym!

title: Ladder strength training
body: Love it, with family schedule and work schedule it was always difficult for me to be creative or execute a killer work out. This app helped (helping) me get back into pushing myself. I jog and bike but now I’m incorporating strength workouts and I feel great.

title: Great workout options
body: There's different options for every level of fitness. I always break a sweat. The coaches are motivating and I the content.

title: Listen to Hilary! This is amazing!
body: I have always struggled keeping up a routine, I have tried all of them, Ladder is the 1st one I can be consistent with and actually look forward to doing! Due to my work schedule, I typically have to do 2-3 workouts per day 3-4 days a week and it is so manageable. I’m sore and I can feel the difference but I’m not dreading it. It’s amazing. Hilary Duff has never led us wrong before and she isn’t starting any time soon! ❤️

title: Love
body: This is such a great workout app!! Truly love the teams and options

title: Love the App just wish they had a family plan!
body: I love ladder have had a wonderful experience with it the only things that would make it so much better is if they offered a family plan for users because my whole household does the gym and we all use ladder.

title: Get er done
body:
I have been doing this for 6 straight weeks with only 1 day off . It is so quick it is easy to stick to . 
Last week I did my Thursday abs in the hall of a hotel . Like I said get er done

title: AMAZING
body: I’ve been accountable for over a year. My body feels better than ever. I recommend this app to everyone. It’s so easy.

title: Best-in-class!
body: I’ve downloaded and deleted so many of these types of app in the past. Finally, along comes Ladder Strength Training with a best-in-class app. Quite simply, Ladder built a better mouse trap!

title: Not hyperbole: life-changing
body: As a lifelong runner I’ve always known strength would be good for me but I have never wanted to do it until now. As I’ve stopped being able to run as much, I thought I would never feel as fit again. Enter Ladder and Team Endure (Coach Jennifer). I love her workouts and love that I can do them daily (my body is clearly not up for running daily now). After six months I’m in shape in a whole new way. My core is stable. I am evening out imbalances. And I feel strong and capable. Sometimes I can even lift more than my husband who has always strength trained. And I can touch my toes! All to say this app and program are just what I need at this stage in my life. All just a half hour or less a day!

title: Excellent App
body: Love the app! User-friendly and very versatile. No planning…all you have to do is show up and work!

title: Amazing
body: Love ladder! Takes the guessing out of it and structures my workout plan every week. Keeps me motivated!

title: Best there is
body: I have tried different trainers, in person/online. Different apps and can honestly say LADDER is THE BEST!

title: Best app for fitness
body: I’ve tried so many apps in order to stay motivated and do workouts from home and nothing has worked!  Being able to choose my team and switch it up when I’m feeling a different style is awesome. I’m excited each day for my next workout and I even decide to do short ones when I’m bored! I highly recommend!

title: GREAT ALL AROUND
body: Amazing app and coaches. I finally found a workout app that works and is truly motivating to continue the work wherever I am in the world.

title: Motivational Consistency
body: I have been using this app for about a month and this has been the most consistent I’ve been with fitness in years. Coach Brian is inspirational, funny, and knowledgeable. He helps change your mindset from seeing workouts as a task to more of an enjoyable hobby. 10/10 would recommend.

title: Loving it!
body: I have done 21 workouts and have been committed for 10 days straight! So far I am loving every workout with Team Evolve! Coach Sam is awesome and encouraging, but gives enough room for us to encourage and hype up ourselves. The programming is simple enough to follow and each exercise comes with multiple swaps for home or gym settings. Such a great program and community!

title: Too much talking about nonsense
body: Little  variety or any help to guide you on weight or the proper motions in advance.  Coaches never stop talking but it’s never about the actual exercise and they just repeat the same nonsense

title: Game changer
body:
If you’re unsure of what to really do in the gym to get results then I would 100% recommend this app. Not only do you get a workout plan each week with the team of your choosing, there are flex workouts, community chats, forums, and now I’m understanding there will even be a podcast for questions we all wonder but don’t have a way to directly ask. 

Ladder was a game changer for me. I have full faith it can be a game changer for a lot of us. 💜 Stay healthy and strong, friends.

title: Love it
body: Never been more disciplined in my life before.  Love that it feel like the coach is right there and helps you push yourself.  Almost 3 years using ladder and I’ve been really enjoying jt

title: Ok
body: Ok

title: Best app ever
body: Got me to workout again and love it!!

title: Great program
body: I have worked out for years and started this app over a year ago and have seen so much growth and gains🩷💪

title: Working well. iPad not connecting to Apple Watch.
body: Love the app. Glad I can use it on my iPad,however there is no ability for me to connect my Apple Watch to sync the work out on my Apple Watch.

title: The best
body: This is the best fitness platform out there and unlike anything else. The app itself is seamless and designed extremely well. Highly recommend. At least give the free trial a shot.

title: Life Altering
body: This app is changing my fitness game and I love it! All I need to do is pick my playlist, show up & show off! As a veteran to fitness, I find the workouts challenging and fun, which keeps me coming back for more! If your goal is to build muscle, move better and improve your quality of life, you’re in the right place!
